与节日一起成长(Growing up with festivals): 一篇关于节日文化的B1记叙文:大卫的经历、感受与成长。

At first, David found it difficult to keep the habit. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. David keeps a small panda at home and feeds it every morning. Best of all, nursery fees swallow a second salary.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. People around David often share different ideas about the dragon boat river. David believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Soft play rescues rainy Saturdays.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. David usually spends the weekend reading at the library. On Sunday evenings, David reviews the notes from class. The children showed their love with drawings.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The experience taught David more than any book could. The dragon boat river looked quieter than usual that evening. Tom is my best friend.
The holiday plan has become an important part of daily life. David bought a sweater online because it was much cheaper. Ben always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
